content: Yuhlak neh Vama Kawng
Te lamloh thoo tih Judea vaang neh Jordan rhalvangan la cet. Te vaengah a taengah hlangping rhoek koep ha puei uh tih a sainoek bangla amih te koep a thuituen.
Tedae Pharisee rhoek loh a paan tih, “Te koinih tongpa te yuu a hlak sak a? tila a dawt uh tih Jesuh te a noemcai uh.
Tedae amih te a doo tih, “

content.text: Moses loh nangmih balae n' uen

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te dongah amih loh, “Moses loh yuhlaknah cayol te a daek sak phoeiah a tueih sak,” a ti uh.
Tedae Jesuh loh amih te, “

content.text: Nangmih kah thinthahnah kongah hekah olpaek he nangmih ham a daek
Suentae cuek lamkah tongpa neh huta ni a saii
Te dongah tongpa loh a manu neh a napa te a toeng vetih a yuu taengah kap ni
Panit te pumsa khat la om ni. Te dongah panit voel pawt tih pumsa khat la om coeng
Te dongah Pathen loh a samtom te hlang loh maa sak boel saeh

content: ,” a ti nah.
Im ah khaw hekah a kawng he hnukbang rhoek loh koep a dawt uh.
Te vaengah amih te, “

content.text: A yuu te a hlak tih a tloe aka yunah te tah a yuu soah samphaih coeng
Huta long khaw a va te a maa tih va tloe a sak atah samphaih coeng

content: ,” a ti nah.
Camoe te Haek Boeh
Te phoeiah camoe rhoek te taek sak ham a taengla a khuen uh. Tedae hnukbang rhoek loh amih te a ho uh.
A hmuh vaengah Jesuh loh a yakdam tih amih te, “

content.text: Hlah uh laeh camoe rhoek te kamah taengah ha lo uh saeh. Amih te kang uh boeh. Pathen kah ram tah amih kah coeng ni
Nangmih taengah rhep ka thui, camoe bangla Pathen kah ram te aka doe pawt te atah ram khuiah kun loengloeng mahpawh

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te phoeiah amih te a poem tih a uem dongah kut a tloeng thil.
Kuirhang neh Pathen Ram
Te phoeiah Jesuh te longpueng ah a caeh li vaengah hlang pakhat loh pak ha cu tih a cungkueng pah. Te phoeiah, “Saya then dungyan hingnah ka pang ham balae ka saii eh?,” tila a dawt.
Jesuh loh anih te, “

content.text: Balae tih kai he a then na ti? Pathen pakhat bueng pawt atah aka then he om pawh
Olpaek te na ming coeng hlang ngawn boeh, samphaih boeh, huencan boeh, laithae boeh, hmuiyoi boeh, na nu na pa te hinyah

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah anih loh, “Saya, te rhoek te ka camoe lamkah boeih ka tuem coeng,” a ti nah.
Tedae Jesuh loh anih te a sawt vaengah a lungnah tih,

content.text: “ Nang pakhat na phavawt pueng, cet lamtah, na khueh boeih te yoi lamtah khodeng rhoek pae. Te daengah ni vaan ah khohrhang na dang eh. Te phoeiah halo lamtah kai m'vai

content: ,” a ti nah.
Tedae hnopai muep aka khueh la a om dongah tekah olka loh moelh a khaih tih kothae doela vik cet.
Khuehtawn neh Pathen Ram
Te vaengah Jesuh loh taengvai a sawt tih a hnukbang rhoek te,

content.text: “ Tangka aka om tah Pathen ram ah kun ham bahoeng kuel mai

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te dongah Jesuh olka dongah hnukbang rhoek tah a ngaihmang uh. Tedae Jesuh loh amih te koep a doo tih, “

content.text: Camoe rhoek aih khaw, Pathen kah ram la kun ham te kuel kahlak la om ta
Kuirhang te Pathen kah ram ah a kun lakah kalauk te phamet khui ah a kun ham phoeng ngai

content: ,” a ti nah.
Tedae te rhoek tah let uh khungdaeng tih amamih te, “Unim aka daem thai ve,” a ti uh.
Jesuh loh amih te a sawt tih, “

content.text: Hlang ham a tloelnah dae Pathen ham tah a tloelnah moenih Pathen taengah tah boeih yoeikoek mai

content: ,” a ti nah.
Peter loh a tong tih, “Kaimih loh boeih ka toeng uh tih nang kam vai uh coeng he,” a ti nah.
Jesuh loh,

content.text: “ Nangmih taengah rhep kan thui, kai ham neh olthangthen ham im khaw, manuca rhoek khaw, ngannu khaw, manu khaw, napa khaw, ca khaw lohmuen khaw aka toeng te om pawh
Tahae tue kah hnaemtaeknah khuiah pataeng im khaw, manuca khaw, ngannu khaw, manu khaw, ca khaw, lohmuen khaw a pueh yakhat la dang het pawt nim? Aka lo ham tue ah dungyan hingnah khaw om pueng
Te dongah lamhma te lamhnuk la, lamhnuk te khaw lamhma la muep om ni

content: ,” a ti nah.
A Duek Ham te a Phoe

Jerusalem la a caeh uh kah longpueng ah a om uh vaengah Jesuh tah amih taengah a lamhma ana om pah. Te dongah a ngaihmang uh tih aka vai rhoek long khaw a rhih uh. Tedae hlainit te koep a khuen tih amah taengah aka thoeng ham te amih taengah thui ham a tong.

content.text: Jerusalem la n'caeh uh he hlang capa tah khosoihham neh cadaek rhoek taengah a paek vetih a duek ham a boe sak uh phoeiah namtom rhoek taengah a thak uh ni
Anih te a tamdaeng uh phoeiah a timthoeih uh ni, a boh uh vetih a ngawn uh ni. Tedae hnin thum phoeiah koep thoo ni

content: ,” a ti nah.
Johan neh James Loh Ngolhmuen A Bih
Te vaengah Zebedee capa rhoi James neh Johan loh a paan rhoi tih, “Saya namah taengah kan bih uh te tah kaimih ham nan saii koinih ka ngaih rhoi,” a ti nah.
Te dongah Jesuh loh amih rhoi te, “

content.text: Nangmih ham kai balae saii sak na ngaih rhoi

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te rhoi long khaw amah te, “Kaimih rhoi he namah kah bantang lamloh pakhat, banvoei lamloh pakhat te m'pae lamtah na thangpomnah dongah ka ngol rhoi eh,” a ti nah.
Jesuh loh amih rhoi taengah, “

content.text: Na bih te na ming rhoi moenih. Ka ok boengloeng te ok ham neh kai aka nuem baptisma dongah nuem ham na noeng aya?

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah te rhoi loh amah te, “Ka noeng ngawn,” a ti nah rhoi. Tedae Jesuh loh amih rhoi taengah, “

content.text: Ka ok boengloeng te na ok rhoi vetih ka nuem baptisma te na nuem rhoi ni
Tedae kai kah banvoei bantang ah ngol ham te kai loh paek ham om pawt tih a hmoel tangtae rhoek ham ni a om

content: ,” a ti nah.
Parha rhoek loh a yaak uh vaengah James neh Johan taengah koe thatlai uh.
Te dongah Jesuh loh amih te a khue tih, “

content.text: Namtom rhoek aka mawt tah amamih aka vueinan tih amamih khuikah aka len loh amih aka huttet la a ngai uh te na ming uh
Nangmih ah te tlam te om boel saeh. Tedae nangmih ah a len la om aka ngaih long tah nangmih kah tueihyoeih la om saeh
Te phoeiah nangmih ah lamhma la om ham aka ngaih long tah hlang boeih kah sal la om saeh
Hlang capa tah hlang thotat sak ham pawt tih sak ham pah ham neh a hinglu te ping kah tlansum la paek

Bartimeaus a Mik Koep tueng
Te phoeiah Jerikho la pawk uh tih Jerikho lamkah a hnukbang rhoek khaw, hlangping khaw huhut khong uh. Te vaengah Timaeus capa Bartimaeus buhbih mikdael te long taengah ngol.
Nazareth Jesuh om tila a yaak vaengah koe pang tih, “David capa Jesuh kai n'rhen lah,” a ti nah.
Te dongah anih te hilphah sak ham muep a sim uh. Tedae te long khaw anah la lat pang tih, “David capa, kai n'rhen lah,” a ti.
Te dongah Jesuh te pai tih, “

content.text: Anih ke khue uh

content: ,” a ti nah. Te dongah mikdael te a khue uh tih, “Thoo, na ngaimong sak, nang n'khue coeng,” a ti nauh.
Te long khaw a himbai te a voeih tih a cungpet doela Jesuh taengah pawk.
Te phoeiah Jesuh loh anih te a doo tih, “

content.text: Na ngaih te kan saii pawn eh

content: ,” a ti nah. Te dongah mikdael loh Jesuh taengah, “Rhabboni, ka hmuh van lah mako,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah Jesuh loh anih te, “

content.text: Cet laeh, namah kah tangnah loh nang n'khang coeng

content: ,” a ti nah. Te vaengah tlek a hmuh tih longpueng ah Jeusuh pahoi a vai.
